problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign parcels to identical delivery trucks. Parcel details:
* Parcel 1: size 46 units
* Parcel 2: size 51 units
* Parcel 3: size 54 units
* Parcel 4: size 31 units
* Parcel 5: size 70 units
* Parcel 6: size 32 units
* Parcel 7: size 61 units
* Parcel 8: size 35 units
* Parcel 9: size 52 units
* Parcel 10: size 48 units
* Parcel 11: size 39 units
* Parcel 12: size 59 units
* Parcel 13: size 45 units
* Parcel 14: size 62 units
* Parcel 15: size 52 units
* Parcel 16: size 40 units
* Parcel 17: size 55 units
* Parcel 18: size 51 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Load all parcels using the minimum number of trucks. Every parcel must be assigned to exactly one truck, and the total size in any truck cannot surpass its capacity limit.
